feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 June 2026 11:43am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 09 June 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low lies to the south of Iceland, with showery troughs crossing the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6, veering West or Northwest this evening or at first tonight and decreasing 4 or 5, then soon decreasing West 3 or 4 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate this evening or at first tonight, slight tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, becoming isolated tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest overnight into Thursday and increasing 5 or 6, possibly touching 7 in southwest of area. Little change on Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, rain and drizzle spreading from the west overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers, moderate or poor in rain and drizzle later.
